tei:div.tei:p: gter mdzod/ yi)pa la/ yang dben ri khrod seng ge'i zab gter phar phyin rgyal ba'i bka' mthu gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa ldeb/ 10 1-20 zangs gling dbang phyug dang zhang khrom gter kha zung 'jug gtad hrul gzhung lag len bcas la ldeb/ 6 21-32 gtad hrul zangs gling ma'i gzhung lag len zhal shes can bka' gter gnyis ldan rig 'dzin rje'i phyag dpe las bshus pa ldeb/ 6 33-44 rata gling dang gnubs lugs khyung po'i man ngag gtad zlog bcas ldeb/ 4 35-51 gtad srung gi dpe'u ris ldeb/ 1 53-54 byang lugs 'dun bshig gwa'u chu sgyur skor ldeb/ 3 55-60 'dun bshig pad gnubs thun mong lugs 'bri gung pa'i phyag bzhes ldeb/ 6 61-71 mi kha zlog pa'i rigs mdor bsdus tshan drug la ldeb/ 5 73-82 a ya bon po'i mi kha dgra sgyur ldeb/ 5 83-92 mchog gling thugs sgrub mi kha srung zlog sogs kyi lag len ldeb/ 8 93-108 lta ngan zlog pa chos dbang phyag bzhes ma ldeb/ 1 109 than zlog shing byang ldeb/ 1 111-112 stag sham yi dgongs khyung gi ltas ngan brgyad cu'i zlog mdos ldeb/ 8 113-128 ༈ gsum pa gsad pa la/ gnubs lugs myur mgyogs stag byang ma ldeb/ 11 129-150 dpe'u ris ldeb/ 1 151 gnyan lugs gza' bdud nam mkha'i hom khung las zhal gdams dang ngan sngags cho 'phrul khyad 'phags rjes gcod lag khrid bcas ring sbrel la ldeb/ 24 153-200 ༈ bzhi pa mtha' sdud 'byung bzhir gtad pa las/ dang po srung ba'i mtha' sdud sa la gnan pa la/ zhang khrom gter ma king dmar rtsa gzhung ldeb/ 6 201-211 bka' gter gnyis ldan gshin rje king dmar byang lugs ldeb/ 6 213-224 dmod byang ldeb/ 1 225-226 blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i de'i lag len ldeb/ 8 227-242 king dmar rlung sgrub gzhung dang lag len zhal shes zhig gling mdzad pa ldeb/ 11 243-264 de'i gsal byed lag len a lo kun mkhyen gsung ldeb/ 6 265-276 king dmar 'bri gung chos grags gsung ldeb/

9 277-293 gnam chos king dmar ldeb/ 1 295 king kang skong ba chags med gsung ldeb/ 1 297-298 'gugs byang ldeb/ 1 299-300 sog zlog pa'i king nag ldeb/ 21 301-342 de'i tshogs mchod sogs smad las ldeb/ 6 343-354 king nag las gzhung phrin las 'dod 'jo ldeb/ 12 355-377 king kang dmar nag gi srung zlog dgra chings mdor bsdus glang ru ma'i rgyun khyer zab dril ldeb/ 8 379-394 de'i zin bris 'jam mgon gsung ldeb/ 10 395-414 byang gter thugs sgrub las tshogs 'gong po ar gtad gter gzhung ldeb/ 5 415-424 de'i lag len chog sgrig 'jam mgon gsung ldeb/ 15 425-454 byang gter phur pa'i sri gnan yi dam spyir 'gror sgyur so can 'jam mgon gsar sgrig ldeb/ 25 455-504 dgra dur phung gsum gnan pa spyi 'gro gsar sgrig ldeb/ 18 505-540 ༈ gnyis pa chu la gtad pa la/ chu gtad las 'brel dregs 'dul thems med kyi gzhung la ldeb/ 7 541-554 ༈ gsum pa gsad pa'i mtha' sdud mer sreg pa la/ sreg pa hom gyi gzer kha spyi 'gro 'jam mgon gsung ldeb/ 8 555-570 ༈ bzhi pa zlog pa'i mtha' sdud rlung la bskur ba la/ rlung 'khrug 'bum gyi yang snying ldeb/ 4 571-578 de'i dpe'u ris ldeb/ 1 579-580 bcas bzhugs//
